settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Manage your account, notifications, and security.

general.title: Language & region
general.intro: Display language and appearance apply immediately on this device; timezone is saved to your account.
general.languageHelp: Applies across the interface and notifications.
general.timezoneHelp: Used to display deadlines, interviews, and events.
general.themeHelp: Choose light, dark, or follow your system.
general.syncUnavailable: Couldn't load saved settings. Changes apply on this device; saving to your account will retry.

notifications.title: Notification preferences
notifications.intro: Choose how you get notified. Some categories are mandatory and cannot be turned off.
notifications.mandatoryHint: Security, legal, and application confirmations are always delivered.
notifications.pushPermissionNote: Push notifications require browser permission and are only enabled after you opt in.
notifications.quietHoursHelp: Pause non-urgent notifications during these hours. Mandatory alerts still come through.

devices.title: Active sessions
devices.intro: Devices currently signed in to your account.
devices.empty: No active sessions to display yet.
devices.revokeBody: This device will be signed out and will need to log in again.
devices.revokeCurrentBody: This is the device you're using now. Signing it out will log you out here.
devices.privacyNote: We store only minimal hints (browser family, OS family, city-level location) — never raw IPs or GPS location.

security.title: Recent security activity
security.intro: Sign-in events, password changes, and new-device alerts.
security.changePasswordIntro: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
security.totpIntro: Add an authenticator app for an extra layer of security.
security.totpSecretLabel: Enter this setup key in your authenticator app:

privacy.consentsIntro: Control how VinUni and partner organizations may use specific data about you.

interview_recording.label: Interview recording
interview_recording.description: Allow partner organizations to record video/audio during interviews scheduled through the platform.

career_outcomes_data_sharing.label: Career outcomes data sharing
career_outcomes_data_sharing.description: Allow the university to include your (de-identified) employment outcome in career outcomes reporting.

privacy.requestsIntro: Request a copy of your data or ask us to delete your account data, subject to legal/record-keeping requirements.
privacy.requestSubmitted: Request submitted. Our team will follow up.
privacy.requestAlreadyPending: You already have a pending request of this type.

settings.permissionRequired: You need to sign in to manage these settings.
